description: Generate images from text prompt. Supports all Recraft models (V4, V4 Vector/SVG, V4 Pro, V3, V2), 70+ styles, color palette control, text layout, and multiple sizes. V4 Vector models produce SVG output.

model.description: Model: recraftv4_1, recraftv4_1_vector, recraftv4_1_pro, recraftv4_1_pro_vector, recraftv4_1_utility, recraftv4_1_utility_vector, recraftv4_1_utility_pro, recraftv4_1_utility_pro_vector, recraftv4, recraftv4_vector, recraftv4_pro, recraftv4_pro_vector, recraftv4_styles, recraftv4_styles_vector, recraftv4_styles_pro, recraftv4_styles_pro_vector, recraftv3, recraftv3_vector, recraftv2, recraftv2_vector

negative_prompt.description: What to exclude from the image

preview.description: Return a small inline preview of the result so it can actually be looked at. Defaults to true. Set false to save context when the image is not being judged.

prompt.description: Image description (max 10,000 chars for V4, 1,000 for V3/V2)

size.description: Image size (e.g., 1024x1024, 1344x768) or ratio (e.g., 16:9, 1:1 for vector models)

style.description: Broad style family. One of: any, digital_illustration, icon, realistic_image, vector_illustration, logo_raster. A specific look (e.g. pixel_art, kawaii, b_and_w) belongs in `substyle`, but passing one here is accepted and routed to the right field.

style_id.description: Custom style UUID (from recraft_create_style). Cannot combine with style.

substyle.description: Specific look within the family — 104 values, validated strictly. Common ones: 2d_art_poster, 3d, 80s, glow, grain, hand_drawn, infantile_sketch, kawaii, pixel_art, psychedelic, seamless, voxel. An invalid value returns the full list.

name: recraft_generate_image
